description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - 2nd Revision for the Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1842/2 of 23.12.2013
reasoning: This gazette content focuses exclusively on amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, detailing interim provisions, general conditions, and methods of promotion for public service officers. It involves public service recruitment, promotion procedures, and administrative instructions issued by the Public Service Commission, which aligns perfectly with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) for public sector services and administration.
